title: HolyClaude: Run Claude Code Anywhere with One Command

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Setting up claude code on a VPS usually means wrestling with dependencies, display issues, and browser sandbox crashes. Holy Cloud is a single Docker Compose file that eliminates all of that. Claude Code CLI, a browser accessible terminal UI, five AI CLIs, and 50 plus development tools pre-installed. Your agent can spin up a web app, navigate to it, take screenshots, and run visual tests without the container falling
